links.reading: Beatrice, your encouragement can help Athena feel brave enough to join in, without asking her to perform on cue. Athena may respond with a hello, a smile, or a few words when the Sunday call feels easy. Keep the invitation warm and let her choose her moment. Behaviour check: See whether one playful invitation helps Athena join the Sunday call.

Beatrice, your enthusiasm can help Athena stay with a hard task after the first try goes badly. Athena may show strong focus when something matters to her, even at three. Offer encouragement without turning persistence into a demand. Behaviour check: Notice whether one kind prompt helps Athena try again after a difficult morning.

Beatrice, you may expect your words to settle the matter, while Athena suddenly wants something different. When the tablet goes off, she may protest or change direction before she can explain why. Keep your instruction short, then give her a moment to react. Behaviour check: When the tablet turns off, pause before repeating the limit.

Beatrice, you may try to keep a plan firm when Athena is tired or unsure. She may not yet understand why a promise cannot cover every change. Keep your words simple and offer comfort without promising what you cannot do. Behaviour check: At bedtime, give one calm answer you can keep.

Beatrice, your quick action can help Athena turn a difficult moment into a fresh start. Athena may respond well when you make the next step small and inviting. This works best when you encourage her without hurrying her. Behaviour check: After a hard morning, offer one easy way for Athena to try again.

Beatrice, you can notice Athena's feelings before she has words for them. She may settle more easily when you soften your voice and stay close, especially at bedtime. Check what she needs rather than guessing, then give her time to answer. Behaviour check: At bedtime, ask Athena what would help before offering comfort.

Beatrice, your wish to comfort Athena may lead you to offer more than she needs. Athena may also take a kind suggestion as a promise, then feel let down when plans change. Use simple, honest words and offer comfort you can follow through on. Behaviour check: Notice whether a clear, small offer helps Athena settle at bedtime.

Beatrice, Athena may shift from one idea to another while you are trying to keep the day clear. At the tablet, a sudden stop can bring a bigger reaction than you expected. Hold the limit, but leave a little time for her to protest and settle. Behaviour check: When the tablet goes off, keep your words brief and wait.

Beatrice, Athena's distress may reach you quickly and strongly, especially when the house is quiet at bedtime. You may want to fix the feeling at once, but your own calm helps her feel safe. Pause, check what she needs, then answer steadily. Behaviour check: At bedtime, notice whether you settle yourself before responding to Athena.

Athena's Sun falls in Beatrice's 1st house, so Beatrice may feel Athena's presence immediately. A small smile or refusal can change how Beatrice enters the morning rush. This can make Athena's growing independence easy to notice, even when she is simply choosing a cup or coat. Behaviour check: Notice whether Beatrice gives Athena one small choice during the morning rush.

Athena's Venus falls in Beatrice's 2nd house, bringing her affection into Beatrice's daily sense of comfort and care. Beatrice may want to give her something familiar when Athena is unsettled. Keep comfort simple, so kindness does not become another promise to manage. Behaviour check: Notice whether one familiar bedtime comfort helps Athena settle.

Athena's Moon falls in Beatrice's 10th house, so Beatrice may feel responsible for how Athena appears to others. A hard moment in public can stay on Beatrice's mind afterward. Athena is still little, and a feeling is not a failure of care. Behaviour check: After a difficult morning, notice whether Beatrice can comfort Athena without judging the moment.

Beatrice's Moon falls in Athena's 2nd house, so Beatrice's daily care can help Athena feel secure. A familiar voice, snack, or bedtime routine may steady her when the day has been full. Athena is still learning what helps, so watch her response rather than assuming. Behaviour check: Ask whether one familiar bedtime routine helps Athena feel settled.

Beatrice's Sun falls in Athena's 3rd house, so Beatrice's words and everyday exchanges can shape how Athena joins in. On the Sunday call, Beatrice may make talking feel playful and safe. Athena may answer in her own time, with a word, a sound, or a wave. Behaviour check: See whether a playful question helps Athena join the Sunday call.
